about: Committed template for the Test checklist (Requirements 27, 28, 30). It names no Drive IDs, hashes, or reviewer observations. Create the local checklist with: cp test_checklist.template.json test_checklist.local.json. The local file is git-ignored, and config.json checklist_path points at it, so the reserved-PDF guard, the status view's Reserved labels, and python tools/check_checklist.py all read the same list. Copy entry shapes from entry_templates into walkthrough or acceptance. Check the walkthrough with: python tools/check_checklist.py --walkthrough-only; check acceptance readiness with: python tools/check_checklist.py

design_mvp_candidates_not_reserved.about: Reference only; the guard and validator never read this list. These are the proposed acceptance PDFs from DESIGN-MVP.md. To reserve one, add a provisional acceptance entry with its filename and drive_file_id in the local checklist. A reviewer then checks the scan, confirms or replaces it, and records expected outcomes before the skill runs.

candidates.candidate_note: Readable multi-run tables, lower-table entries, blank optional fields; staged runs should point to upper-table rows.
Readable multi-run tables, lower-table entries, blank optional fields; staged runs should point to upper-table rows.
Header without a visible date, blank timestamps, a crossed-out upper-table entry; lookup by another verified value; reviewer to decide how the crossed-out entry is treated.
Blank JC cells with a name and date in the header; drafts should keep JC blank and use the name or date for lookup.
Ditto marks in the compound column and a furnace layout; carry-down evidence and the layout link.
Upper-table values without clear run labels. Hold candidate only: expected to hold before extraction only if a reviewer confirms the values cannot be reliably tied to runs.

still_to_identify: a clear PDF with one run
a run that spans PDF pages
a missing growth date with a usable timestamp
a run with no usable lookup value
a confirmed missing or ambiguous stoichiometry case

allowed_values.case_evidence_case: any case the entry claims, plus furnace_layout_sketch and one_critical_run; run_spans_pages evidence cites at least two pages
allowed_values.source_location: pdf_index >= 1 and row >= 1; in case_evidence and blank_or_flagged_fields row may be null with an area such as shared header
allowed_values.reviewer_correction_time: minutes, a non-negative number; tolerances are pending Iris
